name: Pattersonpettai–Solaiyūr District road

tollInfo.note: District roads in India are not tolled.

significance: MDR 1207, Pattersonpettai–Solaiyūr District road, crosses the border between Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh. A state road that runs through more than one state has no single owner — TN Highways and AP R&B each maintain the stretch inside their own state, so which department to contact depends on where along the road you are.
